_meta.purpose: The cross-project field contract. One row per price/spec/availability/delivery/location/FX field group: type, canonical_source, consumed_by, render_moment, conflict_winner. kph-compile and firebase-schema-truth-check read this to know which surface owns which field and who wins on conflict.
sources: Master Plan SS3 table (KPR-284) — render_moment + conflict_winner (authoritative, supplied by Liam)
FIREBASE_SCHEMA_MASTER_v2_2026-05-15.md — field types + live prevalence (audited 2026-05-15, >30d -> treat as suspect, live-verified per LAW 6)
Live key verification 2026-06-24 on KP-ZEN-012 (GET Projects_Public + Project_Inventory) — LAW 6: live wins over doc

render_moment_legend.build: baked into a static surface at build time (website /tour, brochure)
render_moment_legend.runtime: injected into the live Maya prompt at conversation time (prompt-sections / composePrompt)
render_moment_legend.freestyle: the model may quote it conversationally; must still trace to canonical

price.notes: LAW 6: the /Project_Inventory collection more often carries unit_price_thb (71%) than price_thb (47%), but KP-ZEN-012's live records use price_thb -> canonical for this project is price_thb. EN renders THB+USD+EUR, HE renders THB+ILS via fx.json (never mix).

specs.type: bedrooms:number | built_size_sqm:number | pool_sqm:number | total_area_sqm:number | floors:number | plot_size_sqm:number
specs.notes: Headline metric policy = built(indoor)+plot, both shown; pool/terrace named separately, never folded into built area.

availability_lineup.notes: DRIFT: KP-ZEN-012 has no available_count field live; count is derived from configs[].unit_status. Live availability_summary_public prose ('5 available') counts plots, not configs — see _reconcile.md. Never bake per-plot SOLD/RESERVED into print; use dated scarcity count.

delivery_handover.notes: DRIFT: handover_estimate is NOT populated on KP-ZEN-012 live records; SSOT inventory.json .delivery = 'Handover July 2027 (12-13 months from contract)' is the truth. Token resolves to 'July 2027'.

location_map.notes: Live value present: https://maps.app.goo.gl/WwD6Lj9G7uoEyUGD7 ; matches inventory.json location_maps_url.

fx.notes: fx.json supersedes the legacy fx_thb_per_usd 32.5 used by brochure v1/v2 (USD ~1.9% high). EN=THB+USD+EUR, HE=THB+ILS.
